title: Promise Pool
description:
Implement `promisePool(tasks, concurrency)` that runs an array of async task functions with a maximum of `concurrency` running at once. Returns a Promise resolving to results in input order.

**Example:**
```js
const results = await promisePool(
  [() => fetch('/a'), () => fetch('/b'), () => fetch('/c')],
  2
); // at most 2 fetches run simultaneously
```
ai_context: Common mistake: pre-launching all tasks wrapped in Promise.all with slice batches — this creates fixed batches where a slow task blocks the whole batch. The correct approach uses a worker pool that picks up the next task as soon as a slot opens.
